name: maximinion
description: Local-first context guard for AI coding: redact secrets, see token counts, and copy clean, compact code into any AI chat.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Secret warnings, Copy for AI, and sanitization work in Restricted Mode. Semantic folding cannot be enabled by workspace settings until the workspace is trusted.

commands.title: Run Refiner on Active File (Signal Report)

walkthroughs.title: Get Started with MaxiMinion
walkthroughs.description: Share code with AI assistants without leaking secrets or wasting tokens.

steps.title: Copy code for an AI chat
steps.description:
Use **Copy for AI** whenever you paste code into ChatGPT, Copilot Chat, Claude, or any LLM. It redacts likely secrets, compacts whitespace, labels each file, and tells you the estimated token count.
[Copy for AI](command:maximinion.copyForAI)

steps.title: Catch secrets while you edit
steps.description:
Likely secrets are underlined and listed in the **Problems** panel with the source **MaxiMinion**. Use the lightbulb (Ctrl+.) to redact a value in place.
[Open Problems Panel](command:workbench.actions.view.problems)

steps.title: Watch your token budget
steps.description:
The **shield** in the status bar shows the estimated tokens for the current file or selection and turns amber when it exceeds your budget.
[Set Token Budget](command:workbench.action.openSettings?%5B%22maximinion.tokenBudget%22%5D)

steps.title: Analyze a file with the Refiner
steps.description:
The **Refiner** scrubs secrets, scores information density (entropy), and can optionally summarize code with a local Ollama model. Use it to judge whether a file is worth sending, or to shrink a large file.
[Run Refiner on Active File](command:maximinion.runRefinerOnActiveFile)

steps.title: Tune MaxiMinion
steps.description:
Adjust the token budget, warning sensitivity, whitespace compaction, and Refiner options. Every setting includes an explanation.
[Open MaxiMinion Settings](command:maximinion.openSettings)

maximinion.tokenBudget.markdownDescription:
Estimated token budget for **Copy for AI** and the status bar token counter. You are warned when a copy exceeds it, and the status bar turns amber. Set to `0` to disable budget warnings.

Estimates use ~4 characters per token; actual counts vary by model. As a guide, many chat models handle 8k–32k tokens of pasted context comfortably.

maximinion.copyForAI.compactWhitespace.markdownDescription: Trim trailing whitespace and collapse repeated blank lines in **Copy for AI** output to save tokens. Indentation is always preserved, and Markdown hard line breaks are kept.

maximinion.statusBar.enabled.markdownDescription: Show the MaxiMinion token counter (`$(shield) ~N tokens`) in the status bar for the active file or selection. Click it to run **Copy for AI**.

maximinion.secretScrubbing.enabled.markdownDescription:
Redact likely secrets (API keys, cloud credentials, tokens, private keys, connection strings, emails) as `[REDACTED_TYPE]` when using **Copy for AI**, **Preview Sanitized File**, **Copy Sanitized File**, and the **Refiner**. Your source file is never changed by these commands.

Detection is pattern-based and not exhaustive — always review output before sharing.

Can only be changed in your user settings, so a workspace cannot turn redaction off.

maximinion.secretDiagnostics.enabled.markdownDescription:
Underline likely secrets in open files and list them in the **Problems** panel (source: `MaxiMinion`). Use the lightbulb quick fix **Redact with [REDACTED_…]** to replace a value in your file.

Can only be changed in your user settings, so a workspace cannot hide these warnings.

maximinion.secretDiagnostics.minConfiden.markdownDescription:
How confident a pattern must be (0–1) before an inline warning is shown.

- `0.9`+: only very specific formats (AWS, Azure, GitHub, Slack, and OpenAI keys, private keys, JWTs)
- `0.75` (default): also generic `apiKey = "…"` assignments, database URLs with passwords, emails, and SSNs
- `0.6`: also passwords, tokens, generic secrets, and card-like numbers (noisier)

Environment variable references such as `process.env.API_KEY` are never flagged.

Can only be changed in your user settings.

maximinion.entropyScoring.enabled.markdownDescription: Used by **Run Refiner on Active File**. Scores the file's information density with Shannon entropy (bits per character): `HIGH` means dense, varied content (real logic); `LOW` means repetitive or boilerplate content that is a good candidate to trim before sharing.

maximinion.semanticFolding.enabled.markdownDescription:
**Off by default.** Tick to let **Run Refiner on Active File** summarize the file with a local [Ollama](https://ollama.com) model at `http://localhost:11434` to cut tokens further. Lossy: review the summary before relying on it. Requires Ollama to be running, the model in **Semantic Folding: Model** to be installed, and **Entropy Scoring** to be enabled. Ollama cloud models, which would send code off your machine, are refused unless you turn on **Semantic Folding: Allow Remote Models**.

When you turn this on, MaxiMinion checks that Ollama is reachable and the model is installed. If the check fails, folding is turned off again and you're told how to fix it.

[Test Setup](command:maximinion.testSemanticFolding) runs the check plus a sample fold, without turning folding on.

maximinion.semanticFolding.model.markdownDescription:
Ollama model used for semantic folding, for example `phi3`, `llama3.2`, or `gemma4:26b`. It must already be installed (`ollama pull <model>`); run `ollama list` to see installed models. If it is missing, the Refiner offers to switch to an installed model. Small models are fastest; thinking models run with thinking turned off. Changing the model re-runs the setup check while folding is on.

[Test Setup](command:maximinion.testSemanticFolding)

maximinion.semanticFolding.allowRemoteMo.markdownDescription:
**Off by default.** Ollama cloud models (for example `gpt-oss:120b-cloud`) run on another host: your local Ollama forwards the code to it, so the code leaves your machine. MaxiMinion refuses them unless you tick this. Secret redaction still runs first, but review what you send.

Can only be changed in your user settings, so a workspace cannot turn it on.

maximinion.manifest.exportFormat.markdownDescription: Format of the Refiner report written to the **MaxiMinion** output channel (View → Output → MaxiMinion).

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run typecheck && npm run build
